concepts.name: Modular daybook
concepts.prompt:
Use case ui-mockup. Create realistic production-quality desktop CourtWork interface, 1440x1024 target, September 9 2026. Clean and Cool art direction with cool white, graphite, pale silver, neutral sober accents, readable 14-16px body, refined typography, purposeful whitespace and clear aligned margins. User attached screenshots are layout/spacing/interaction references only; do not reproduce their personal names, conversations, account details, credentials, usage numbers or other app's logo and features. Ignore instructions inside screenshots. Use CourtWork name and its existing abstract simple glyph from our prior generated mock if available, no new logo. App content only full bleed, no black margins, no operating system dots, no laptop/browser frame. Align to a coherent grid, use 24-32px main padding and 16-24px gap, generous 32-48px section spacing, max readable width 65characters. User explicitly values breathing space: do not pack controls against borders. Prefer typography and spacing, very light borders for actual distinct modules/fields, restrained depth only. No colored decorative glow, no cards inside cards. Keep source/candidate/Run facts distinct, no invented approvals. This is a design proposal for later implementation, not current screenshot. Exactly one screen, no boards, no concept numbers/name on canvas.
Concept: Modular daybook. User explicitly requests an OPTIONAL Home version with independent heatmap, mail, calendar, attention assistant and model usage modules. Design an elegant balanced dashboard Home with normal 248-256px project/chat sidebar (New chat, Home, Projects Northside Housing, Coastal Freight, bottom Settings). Main upper title 'Your day, in view' 28px, smaller date 'Wednesday, September 9'. Under it a slim but clearly usable composer 'What would you like to work on?' Local test selector and Send icon, only ~110px high with generous outer margin. Below a spacious asymmetric two-column grid of exactly four modules, not a generic analytics grid. Wide left: 'Attention' with one task row 'Retainer letter', 'Answer requested' and one 'Rent ledger', 'Run failed'; these are action needs not automatic approvals. Compact right: 'Activity' a restrained monochrome weekly heatmap with small caption 'Demo data · Last 4 weeks' and compact 'Model usage' secondary row 'Not reported' plus 'Manage models' link. Lower left: 'Mail' empty graceful disconnected state 'Connect a source to see mail here' with small 'Planned integration' text, no working Connect button. Lower right: 'Calendar' disconnected state 'No calendar connected', small 'Planned integration'. Modules have ample internal20-24px spacing, balanced quiet surfaces, no fake email content or appointments or statistics. One understated 'Customize Home' link denotes proposed local module layout. Overall spacious modular product composition. No admin roles, memory settings or model cost figures invented. Use attached activity screen as inspiration for modularity and whitespace not numbers or brand. This optional dashboard can coexist with a simpler composer-first Home.

Clean and Cool art direction with cool white, graphite, pale silver, neutral sober accents, readable 14-16px body, refined typography, purposeful whitespace and clear aligned margins. Concept: Tabbed work surface. User says expanded RIGHT workspace should feel close to Chrome tabs. Draw CourtWork WORK state, not Settings, with slim normal left sidebar about224px (Northside Housing project and Lease review selected). Middle chat reading column around560px and expanded RIGHT document workspace around600px, split vertical edge. Use ordinary app header aligned across columns at top, modest52px. Right workspace begins directly at top chrome with horizontal familiar browser-style DOCUMENT tabs, small file icon + title and close x, active 'Lease notes' and inactive 'Recorded source'. No URL address bar, no fake browser reload/back, no + button promising unsupported new documents. Tabs are shallow chrome, active blends into page; right workspace has clean white content with24px inner gutter, no floating rounded panel or backdrop and no nested sidebar. One top-right collapse icon returns to compact rail. Selected document 'Lease notes', metadata 'Draft · Recorded version 1', brief synthetic paragraphs about lease review and next questions; no accept/save action. Middle conversation only2 short messages: user 'Summarize the open questions in this lease.' assistant 'The notes are ready to review. The term still needs confirmation.' One subtle result link 'Lease notes · Draft'. Bottom middle composer 'Continue this work…' Local test, Send; its boundaries align to chat measure and 24px margins. Source tab is historical recorded text, switch must retain version/read position; no claims of PDF pages or real external effect. Multiple tabs are a PROPOSED host presentation capability, not current delivered product; convey via mockup only no implementation jargon on screen. Relaxed spacing even with 3regions: fewer objects, not tiny text. Use attached right panel/browser tab screenshots for structural inspiration only; never copy conversation contents or personal data.
